craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder-sprinkle. Rows: ground then blooms. Rejected: smoothing the junction — killed: flagged obscure, rite-sense kept. Read aloud: soft tread.

lines: Ground made ready, dew-fresh with wonder's taste —
with plucked mind-blooms, self-natured, breathing their own sweet.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitām āttair mānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasaṃdohibhiḥ
